isolation: Each scenario drove its own independent OAuth2/PKCE sign-in against Thunder SSO (separate browser sessions per caller: one for Sam, a separate one for Jordan, both against the test-caller login published on the roles-gate ticket) and called the deployed GET /greeting endpoint directly. The endpoint is stateless and read-only with no container to own, so isolation came from fresh independent sign-ins and tokens per scenario rather than from a resettable resource; no shared state was mutated or depended upon between scenarios.

scenarios.rule: Only a signed-in caller may request the greeting
scenarios.scenario: A signed-in caller receives the greeting

steps.text: Sam has signed in via Thunder SSO
steps.command: agent-browser PKCE authorize+login against development-idp.openchoreo.localhost/oauth2/authorize as test-caller, then POST /oauth2/token to exchange the code
steps.observed: HTTP/1.1 200 OK, access_token issued with scope 'openid greeting:read'

steps.command: grep -q '^HTTP/1.1 200' headers_sam_greeting.txt && python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('resp_sam_greeting.json')); sys.exit(0 if d.get('message') else 1)"

scenarios.rule: Only a signed-in caller may request the greeting

steps.command: no sign-in performed — no token obtained

scenarios.scenario: The greeting does not vary between callers

steps.text: Sam and Jordan have both signed in via Thunder SSO
steps.command: two independent agent-browser PKCE sign-ins in separate sessions (acc-abdd7afecb14 for Sam, acc-jordan-1790957473 for Jordan) against test-caller, each exchanged for its own access token via POST /oauth2/token
steps.observed: both exchanges returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with distinct access tokens

steps.text: Sam requests the hello-world greeting and Jordan requests the hello-world greeting
steps.observed: both HTTP/1.1 200 OK, bodies {"message":"Hello, world!"} and {"message":"Hello, world!"}

steps.text: they receive the same greeting message
steps.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; a=json.load(open('resp_sam_greeting.json')); b=json.load(open('resp_jordan_greeting.json')); sys.exit(0 if a.get('message') and a.get('message')==b.get('message') else 1)"
